name: Thermodynamics for Aerospace
summary: Engineering thermodynamics aimed at propulsion and aerodynamics: energy balances, entropy, gas properties and power and propulsion cycles.

topics.name: Ideal gas law, specific heats and calorically perfect gases
First law for closed systems and control volumes; enthalpy
Steady-flow energy equation for nozzles, diffusers, compressors and turbines
Second law, entropy and isentropic processes
Brayton cycle and its variants (regeneration, reheat, intercooling)
Otto and Diesel cycles for piston aero engines
Rankine and closed Brayton cycles for space power
Thermochemistry: heats of formation and combustion
Chemical equilibrium and adiabatic flame temperature (introduction)
